about: Craft checklist, department animation (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/animation-principles/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: squash and stretch keep the volume
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §4 (SUPPORTED): Wikipedia, the twelve principles (Thomas and Johnston 1981)

criteria.name: staging: one idea read at a glance
pose to pose: keyframe and next pose carry the action, the model fills between
slow in and slow out on limbs, not only on the camera
secondary action (hair, cloth, breath) is free
timing: shot rhythm and hold share
criteria.source: repo: BP-107, BP-109 (the creator's cartoons measured)

criteria.name: exaggeration in the caricature, never in the facts
solid drawing: no duplicated or missing limbs
appeal: the hero stays on model (hero references, D-55)
a held character breathes: blink cadence and a moving hold on long holds
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): blink every 2-4 s, moving hold after 2 s (CRAFT_SOURCES §4)

criteria.name: a planted foot does not slide
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): no pixel limit; measure on the creator's cartoons (CRAFT_SOURCES §4)

criteria.name: lip-sync offset and confidence measured on every full-tier spoken shot
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §5 (SUPPORTED): Chung and Zisserman, SyncNet method; the 80 ms limit is NOT FOUND

criteria.name: identity score against the hero sheet, threshold calibrated on our own sheets
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §5 (SUPPORTED): Deng et al., ArcFace method; no cartoon threshold
